verses.text_uthmani: سَبَّحَ لِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ

translations.text: Everything in the heavens and earth glorifies God––He is the Almighty, the Wise.
Allah ki tasbeeh ki hai har us cheez ne jo aasmano aur zameen mein hai, Aur woh ghalib (Mighty) aur Hakeem (wise) hai

verses.text_uthmani: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لِمَ تَقُولُونَ مَا لَا تَفْعَلُونَ

translations.text: You who believe, why do you say things and then do not do them?
Aey logon jo iman laye ho, tum kyun woh baat kehte ho jo karte nahin ho

verses.text_uthmani: كَبُرَ مَقْتًا عِندَ ٱللَّهِ أَن تَقُولُوا۟ مَا لَا تَفْعَلُونَ

translations.text: It is most hateful to God that you say things and then do not do them;
Allah ke nazdeek yeh sakht na pasandeeda harakat hai ke tum kaho woh baat jo karte nahin

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحِبُّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُقَـٰتِلُونَ فِى سَبِيلِهِۦ صَفًّا كَأَنَّهُم بُنْيَـٰنٌ مَّرْصُوصٌ

translations.text: God truly loves those who fight in solid lines for His cause, like a well-compacted wall.
Allah ko to pasand woh log hain jo uski raah mein is tarah saff-basta(row) hokar ladte hain goya ke woh ek sisa pilayi hui deewar hain

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِذْ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِقَوْمِهِۦ يَـٰقَوْمِ لِمَ تُؤْذُونَنِى وَقَد تَّعْلَمُونَ أَنِّى رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ إِلَيْكُمْ ۖ فَلَمَّا زَاغُوٓا۟ أَزَاغَ ٱللَّهُ قُلُوبَهُمْ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يَهْدِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلْفَـٰسِقِينَ

translations.text: Moses said to his people, ‘My people, why do you hurt me when you know that I am sent to you by God?’ When they went astray, God left their hearts to stray: God does not guide rebellious people.

Aur yaad karo Moosa ki woh baat jo usne apni qaum se kahi thi “Aey meri qaum ke logon, tum kyun mujhey aziyat (torment /harm) dete ho halaanke tum khoob jaante ho ke main tumhari taraf Allah ka bheja hua Rasool hoon? Phir jab unhon ne tedh ikhtiyar ki (deviated) to Allah ne unke dil tedhey (deviant) kardiye, Allah faasiqon ko hidayat nahin deta

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِذْ قَالَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ يَـٰبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ إِنِّى رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ إِلَيْكُم مُّصَدِّقًا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَىَّ مِنَ ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةِ وَمُبَشِّرًۢا بِرَسُولٍ يَأْتِى مِنۢ بَعْدِى ٱسْمُهُۥٓ أَحْمَدُ ۖ فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ قَالُوا۟ هَـٰذَا سِحْرٌ مُّبِينٌ

translations.text: Jesus, son of Mary, said, ‘Children of Israel, I am sent to you by God, confirming the Torah that came before me and bringing good news of a messenger to follow me whose name will be Ahmad.’ Yet when he came to them with clear signs, they said, ‘This is obviously sorcery.’

Aur yaad karo Isa ibn-e-Maryam ki woh baat jo usne kahi thi ke “Aey bani Israel, main tumhari taraf Allah ka bheja hua Rasool hoon, Tasdeeq (verify/confirm) karne wala hoon us Taurat ki jo mujhse pehle aayi hui maujood hai, aur basharat (khushkhabri) dene wala hoon ek rasool ki jo mere baad aayega jiska naam Ahmed hoga. Magar jab woh unke paas khuli khuli nishaniyan lekar aaya to unhon ne kaha yeh to sareeh dhoka hai

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ ٱفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلْكَذِبَ وَهُوَ يُدْعَىٰٓ إِلَى ٱلْإِسْلَـٰمِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يَهْدِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ

translations.text: Who could be more wrong than someone who invents lies against God when called to submit to Him? God does not guide the wrongdoers:

Ab bhala us shaks se bada zaalim aur kaun hoga jo Allah par jhutey bohtan bandhey halaanke usey Islam (Allah ke aagey sar-e-itaat jhuka deney) ki dawat di ja rahi ho? Aisey zaalimon ko Allah hidayat nahin diya karta

verses.text_uthmani: يُرِيدُونَ لِيُطْفِـُٔوا۟ نُورَ ٱللَّهِ بِأَفْوَٰهِهِمْ وَٱللَّهُ مُتِمُّ نُورِهِۦ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ

translations.text: they wish to put His light out with their mouths. But He will perfect His light, even though the disbelievers hate it;
Yeh log apni mooh ki phoonkon (blows) se Allah ke noor ko bujhana chahte hain, Aur Allah ka faisla yeh hai ke wo apne noor ko poora phayla kar rahega khwa kaafiron ko yeh kitna hi nagawar ho

verses.text_uthmani: هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَرْسَلَ رَسُولَهُۥ بِٱلْهُدَىٰ وَدِينِ ٱلْحَقِّ لِيُظْهِرَهُۥ عَلَى ٱلدِّينِ كُلِّهِۦ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ ٱلْمُشْرِكُونَ

translations.text: it is He who sent His Messenger with guidance and the religion of truth to show that it is above all [other] religions, even though the idolaters hate it.
Wahi to hai jisne apne Rasool ko hidayat aur deen-e-haqq ke saath bheja hai taa-ke usey poorey ke poorey deen par ghalib karde khwa mushrikeen ko yeh kitna hi nagawar ho

verses.text_uthmani: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ هَلْ أَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَىٰ تِجَـٰرَةٍ تُنجِيكُم مِّنْ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ

translations.text: You who believe, shall I show you a bargain that will save you from painful torment?
Aey logon jo iman laye ho, main bataoon tumko wo tijarat jo tumhein azaab-e-aleem se bacha de

verses.text_uthmani: تُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ وَتُجَـٰهِدُونَ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ بِأَمْوَٰلِكُمْ وَأَنفُسِكُمْ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمْ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ

translations.text: Have faith in God and His Messenger and struggle for His cause with your possessions and your persons––that is better for you, if only you knew-
Iman lao Allah aur uske Rasool par, Aur jihad karo Allah ki raah mein apne maalon se aur apni jaano se, yahi tumhare liye behtar hai agar tum jaano

verses.text_uthmani: يَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ذُنُوبَكُمْ وَيُدْخِلْكُمْ جَنَّـٰتٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ وَمَسَـٰكِنَ طَيِّبَةً فِى جَنَّـٰتِ عَدْنٍ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ

translations.text: and He will forgive your sins, admit you into Gardens graced with flowing streams, into pleasant dwellings in the Gardens of Eternity. That is the supreme triumph.

Allah tumhare gunaah maaf kardega, aur tumko aisey baaghon mein daakhil karega jinke nichey nehrein behti hongi, aur abadi (eternal) qayaam ki jannaton mein behtareen ghar tumhein ata farmaeyga. Yeh hai badi kamiyabi

verses.text_uthmani: وَأُخْرَىٰ تُحِبُّونَهَا ۖ نَصْرٌ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَفَتْحٌ قَرِيبٌ ۗ وَبَشِّرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

translations.text: And He will give you something else that will really please you: His help and an imminent breakthrough. [Prophet], give the faithful the good news.
Aur woh dusri cheez jo tum chahte ho woh bhi tumhein dega, Allah ki taraf se nusrat (victory) aur kareeb hi mein hasil ho janey wali fatah. Aey Nabi ehle iman ko iski basharat de do

verses.text_uthmani: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ كُونُوٓا۟ أَنصَارَ ٱللَّهِ كَمَا قَالَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ لِلْحَوَارِيِّـۧنَ مَنْ أَنصَارِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ قَالَ ٱلْحَوَارِيُّونَ نَحْنُ أَنصَارُ ٱللَّهِ ۖ فَـَٔامَنَت طَّآئِفَةٌ مِّنۢ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَكَفَرَت طَّآئِفَةٌ ۖ فَأَيَّدْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ عَلَىٰ عَدُوِّهِمْ فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ ظَـٰهِرِينَ

translations.text: You who believe, be God’s helpers. As Jesus, son of Mary, said to the disciples, ‘Who will come with me to help God?’ The disciples said, ‘We shall be God’s helpers.’ Some of the Children of Israel believed and some disbelieved: We supported the believers against their enemy and they were the ones who came out on top.

Aey logon jo iman laye ho, Allah ke madadgaar bano , jis tarah Isa ibn-e-Maryam ne hawariyon (disciples) ko khitaab karke kaha tha “Kaun hai Allah ki taraf (bulane) mein mera madadgaar”. Aur hawariyon (disciples) ne jawab diya tha : “hum hai Allah ke madadgaar”. Us waqt bani Israel ka ek giroh iman laya aur dusre giroh ne inkar kiya. Phir humne iman laney walon ki unke dushmano ke muqable mein taeed ki (aided) aur wahi ghalib hokar rahey
